remote.title: Connect a remote Fresh Air Assistant
remote.description: Remote connections are deliberately limited to Tailscale addresses. Only the current state of the remote Fresh Air Assistant is transferred; its sensors and history are not created in this Home Assistant. “Continue” first tests the connection. It is saved only after the following success confirmation.

**✓ Connection successful**

{details}

Now choose the shared rooms that should be shown on this instance. New rooms will only become available for selection later and will not be added automatically.

The updated connection details work.

user.title: Add ventilation station
user.description: Choose whether the station is already connected directly to this Home Assistant via ESPHome or communicates through a ventilation-station master / ESP-NOW.

direct.title: Assign direct ESPHome station
direct.description: Select an ESPHome device already integrated into Home Assistant. It is only offered when exactly one CO₂, temperature and humidity sensor can be identified. All three are used automatically as the room source.

master.title: Assign station via master
master.description: Assign a station discovered by the ESP-NOW master to a room. The hardware ID can also be entered manually.

error.hardware_room_duplicate: A ventilation station is already assigned to this room.
error.hardware_direct_device_invalid: The selected ESPHome device is no longer available or does not expose an unambiguous CO₂, temperature and humidity sensor set.

abort.hardware_no_rooms: Create at least one room first.
